children: Svevia AB has appointed NRC Group Sverige AB, a company wholly owned by NRC Group ASA, to a contract for BEST-works at Malmö Godsbangård.

The contract is valued at approximately SEK 70 million. The scope of work includes rail services such as track, electro, groundwork and catenary. The work is scheduled to commence in Q4 2026 and is scheduled for completion in September 2029.
For further information, please contact: Åsgeir Nord, CFO of NRC Group, + 47 957 34 985.

This information is subject to disclosure under the Norwegian Securities Trading Act, §5-12. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-09-02 17:19 CEST.
This stock exchange announcement was published by Charlotte Krog, Communication, NRC Group ASA.

title: NRC Group ASA - Appointed to a rail contract in Sweden - SEK 70 million
